lines.t: intro
“Arise, My children. Stand firm, for the night is full of wolves.
Drink deeply of the living waters.
Clothe yourselves with truth and wisdom, for the time is coming when only the faithful shall endure.
Prepare, and the Presence of God shall dwell within you.”
wolves move silent in borrowed skin
whispers dressed like truth and hymn
they circle wide, they wait inside
to tear the flock and steal the light
but there’s a sound that cuts the air
a trumpet call both fierce and clear
the lost arise, they turn and see
a path that leads to liberty
pre-chorus
those with ears will hear the tone
a voice that says, “you’re not alone”
come and drink, the water’s near
wash away the dust and fear
chorus
i’m clothed with the presence of God, reborn within
washed alive, no trace of sin
hidden now, but standing firm
until the day the fire returns
i’m clothed with the presence of God, awake and sealed
eyes of flame, my heart revealed
truth and wisdom on my tongue
i walk the road, thy will be done
verse 2
i drink deep from the living stream
not the world, not empty dreams
going out and coming in
learning how to truly live
every step upon the stone
not my strength, not mine alone
oil upon my weary feet
prepared to stand, prepared to meet
pre-chorus
no longer blind, no longer bound
the veil is torn, the truth resounds
i remain, i abide
where your presence is my guide
chorus
I’m clothed with the presence of God, reborn within
washed alive, no trace of sin
hidden now, but standing firm
until the day the fire returns
i’m clothed with the presence of God, awake and sealed
eyes of flame, my heart revealed
truth and wisdom on my tongue
i walk the road, thy will be done
salvation guards my mind
your name is over mine
faith held steady in my hand
i stand upon the rock, i stand
your word is sharp, your truth my blade
every lie is unmade
i lift the shield, i do not run
the battle’s yours, the victory won
i'm clothed with the presence of God, prepared to stand
marked and sealed by your command
through the night, through time unseen
i walk with you, the living King
i’m clothed with the presence of God, i will not fear
your voice alone is all i hear
until the day you split the sky
i live for you, i testify
